title: Transitions
summary: GPU shader transitions in the theme's look, shown going from the graded sample clip to a graphics frame: seven of its own, moved in held steps like stop-motion (a paper rip, cross tears with tint steps, a tape peel, a xerox dissolve, a stutter cut, an ink splat, a crumple), and seven from the shared set, drawn in the theme's colours (white fibre rims and paper backs on soot).
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "paper_rip", "seconds": 0.6}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "cross_tears", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.5}]. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl); this theme's own shaders and its colours for the shared ones are in transitions/theme_transitions.py.

items.name: paper rip
items.description: A tear runs across the frame, then the two halves are pulled apart, each with a white fibre edge. The theme default.

items.name: cross tears
items.description: Four held frames: strips are ripped out at different angles while the picture flips through teal, plum and brick prints, then a hard cut.

items.name: tape peel
items.description: The shot is peeled off from the top like a length of masking tape, rolling back to show a buff crepe-paper back.

items.name: crumple
items.description: The shot is screwed up like a sheet of paper: creases break it into facets, it shrinks to a ragged ball and drops out of the frame.

items.name: stutter cut
items.description: Eight held frames: the two shots jump, shove sideways and flash through as teal and red prints before the cut lands.

items.name: slice slide
items.description: The frame is cut into nine horizontal strips that tilt and slide off to alternate sides, each with a white paper edge. A cut-up, shredded look.

items.name: shatter
items.description: The frame breaks into small square scraps that tumble toward the camera, centre first, white-edged with paper backs. Like a handful of cut photographs thrown at the lens.

items.name: accordion fold
items.description: The frame folds up like a leaflet toward the left edge, uncovering the next shot.

items.name: swing doors
items.description: The frame splits down the middle and both halves swing away like a folded flyer opening.

items.name: xerox dissolve
items.description: The shot is photocopied down to soot and bone, breaks up into toner specks and streaks that are already the next shot, and that clears.

items.name: ink splat
items.description: Soot ink splats land one after another, spiky, with flung drops, and spread until they join; the next shot shows through them.

items.name: luma melt
items.description: Columns of the old shot drip downward at different speeds while its bright areas burn through first with an orange edge. Wet ink running down a wall.

items.name: noise dissolve
items.description: Three sizes of blocky noise eat the old shot away like toner dropout, with white specks on the dissolve front. Keep it short (0.3 s).

items.name: zoom through
items.description: A hard zoom-blur punch through the old shot into the new one.
